core_obligations: Item (1) (proof lines 966-973): from ax:lnot1 get both not A |- A -> falsum and not B |- B -> falsum as derivability statements via the deduction theorem; ax:lor3 fuses them into {not A, not B} |- (A or B) -> falsum; the deduction theorem run backwards delivers {A or B, not A, not B} |- falsum, i.e. inconsistency of the triple.
Item (2) (lines 974-975): each introduction A |- A or B, B |- A or B is one modus ponens from the corresponding axiom.
proof_roadmap: Reformulate each negation as a refutation of its disjunct.
Discharge with the deduction theorem; introductions are axiom instances.

H2: assembly over the deduction theorem with every citation written at the inference site.
